name: 顾娘子
inputMode: text-to-model; existing male merchant is not input

payload.prompt: Full-body game character, Gu Niangzi, a fictional 42-year-old Chinese woman running a modest general-goods stall in Northern Song inspired Bianjing. Mature natural facial features, clear eyes, calm brisk expression, dark hair gathered into a simple practical bun. Muted dark green modest wrap-front robe with narrow sleeves, plain brown cloth outer layer, simple fabric waist tie, long practical skirt and cloth shoes. No royal costume or costly jewelry. Relaxed neutral A-pose with both empty hands clearly separated from body, five fingers on each hand, stable planted feet. Single anatomically correct figure; front face only on front, hair bun on back. Restrained semi-realistic low-poly PBR style matching the existing Qingming game, readable face and cloth seams for close dialogue shots. No abacus or ceramic cup fused into hands; props will be separate local assets.
payload.negative_prompt: male, young girl, duplicate face, extra limbs, extra fingers, fused hands, Qing queue, qipao, modern clothes, imperial crown, weapon, abacus, cup, background scenery, pedestal, painted shadows, shiny plastic skin

recipeNotes: Text input does not use image-only texture_alignment/orientation options
Rig v2.5 biped follows fixed project recipe and official sample; stop on incompatibility, do not silently switch rig
Published detailed pricing differs across official pages; reserve conservative upper estimate
No automatic reroll, topology processing, texture upgrade or format conversion

acceptance.dedicatedPickUpAndInspectCup: local authoring after body accepted; not covered by idle/walk

download to part then validate GLB before rename
